adapter.label: Tailscale private Serve
adapter.needs: Needs Tailscale installed and signed in on this computer and port 9444 or 9445 free. Only devices on your tailnet can reach it.

durable.needs: Needs Tailscale installed and signed in on this computer and port 443, 8443 or 10000 free. Only devices on your tailnet can reach it.

address.scope: DNS name of this node plus an unused port
conditions: tailnet HTTPS and MagicDNS must be enabled
node and tailnet identity stay the same

cost.summary: Tailscale pricing is documented, but the Serve page does not say which plans include Serve.

disclosure.text: Publish this service over HTTPS on an unused private Tailscale Serve port of this device. Only tailnet clients can reach it. Existing listeners stay untouched.

protocols.sse/streamableHttp: true. Backed by validation.sse (timed incremental event delivery when required) and validation.publish (exact-origin approval only after all required probes) in the wrapped recipe definition, with admission.requiredFeatures probe-assertions and client-vantage-probe.
protocols.oauthDcr: oauthDcr: Serve publishes a stable HTTPS origin and Gozar preserves the configured authority.
